Summary: Set up FastAPI backend & SQLite evidence database schema
Description:
Set up initial FastAPI backend repository and configure SQLite database schema for secure evidence storage.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. FastAPI project structure initialized with clean architecture.
2. SQLite schema created with tables for Users, Artifacts, Analysis Results, and Audit Logs.
3. Basic database connection tests passing.

Summary: Build URL & Domain metadata extraction API endpoint
Description:
Implement backend endpoint in FastAPI to parse suspicious URLs/domains, retrieve DNS records, WHOIS data, and security threat scores.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. POST /api/v1/scan/url accepts valid URL string.
2. Extracts domain age, registrar info, and IP reputation.
3. Returns threat risk score (0-100) and saves result to SQLite.

Summary: Implement Email header & EML file parser
Description:
Create parser service to extract hop headers, sender IP, DKIM/SPF validation, and suspicious attachment details from uploaded .eml files.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Accepts .eml files up to 25MB.
2. Extracts sending IP chain and flags spoofing indicators.
3. Output formatted in clean JSON structure for UI consumption.

Summary: Build Browser History & File hash analysis module
Description:
Extract browser history files (SQLite/Chrome/Firefox format) and compute file hashes (MD5, SHA-256) for suspicious file uploads.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Computes MD5 and SHA-256 hashes within 5 seconds for files < 50MB.
2. Parses browser history DB files and extracts top visited domains and timestamps.
3. Results logged to evidence vault.

Summary: Create React evidence upload & scan dashboard
Description:
Design and build drag-and-drop file/URL submission interface in React with real-time processing status indicators.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Supports file drag-and-drop and URL text input.
2. Displays progress spinner and clear status updates during extraction.
3. Displays high-contrast threat score badges upon completion.

Build UI data table in React with search, sorting, and filtering capabilities across historical evidence records.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Search by keyword, hash, IP address, or investigator ID.
2. Filter by risk level (High, Medium, Low) and date range.
3. Pagination supports 25, 50, and 100 records per page.

Build investigator authentication and immutable audit logging system for chain-of-custody compliance.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Role-based login for Investigators and Admin leads.
2. Every scan, view, or export action logged with timestamp, user ID, and target hash.
3. Audit logs read-only and exportable.

Run benchmark tests against benign sample datasets to calibrate threat scoring algorithms and reduce false positives.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Run test suite against 100 known clean files/URLs and 100 malicious samples.
2. False positive rate reduced to under 3%.
3. QA sign-off document attached to ticket.

Develop feature allowing investigators to export evidence analysis into a structured PDF executive report.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. One-click export button on scan results page.
2. Generates clean PDF report including summary, extracted metadata, and chain-of-custody log.

Prepare user manual, architecture diagram overview, and present final deployment demo to client stakeholders.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. User guide document completed.
2. Final client demo completed with official sign-off.
